summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom the Fates killed with brazen clubs in the Gigantomachy — the Thoas named in Apollodorus 1.6.2, not the Lemnian or Aetolian kings of the same name.

story.text: Apollodorus names Thoas among the Giants destroyed when the Olympians fought with Heracles at their side: the Fates, fighting with brazen clubs, killed Agrius and Thoas. The collective node `gigantes` holds the Gigantomachy; this node is the individual in the battle roster.
The atlas keeps this Thoas distinct from `thoas-lemnos`, king of Lemnos and father of Hypsipyle; `thoas-aetolia`, the Aetolian king; and `thoas-dulichium`, the Ithacan suitor.
